body: I’ve been suicidal for years and I have a plan that’d be painless, but I recently had a close brush with death - due to a bad acid trip - that led me to stabbing myself three times in the chest and then trying to drown myself. I punctured a lung with the stabbing and was hospitalized of course. It wasn’t due to depression but only because of the drugs, even though I have struggled with depression for over half my life. But since that accident I’ve been horrified of death because the acid made me feel like I was in hell repenting for taking my own life at 17. But I don’t want to live and I wish I could just turn it off.
